# BossBoard

> BossBoard is a mobile-first business-management app for New Zealand tradies. The product is free during beta; Tradie and Team paid tiers are listed for when billing launches. AI-assisted SWMS drafts are templates and starting material, not legal advice — the operator stays the PCBU. Published by Instilligent Limited (NZBN 9429041896853).

BossBoard is a mobile-first business management app for New Zealand tradespeople (electricians, plumbers, builders, etc.) with AI-assisted compliance-doc drafting.

## About
BossBoard streamlines the "paperwork" of running a trade business. It provides AI-assisted compliance-doc drafts (templates and starting material, not legal advice — operator reviews and signs off), GST-ready invoicing, job tracking, and team management in a single offline-first application.

## Key Features
- **AI SWMS**: AI-assisted SWMS template generation aligned with the NZ Health and Safety at Work Act 2015 — templates and starting material, not legal advice. While the operator stays accountable as the PCBU, the first draft is done in seconds, not hours.
- **Invoicing & Quotes**: Professional documents with 15% GST built in.
- **Job Tracking**: Real-time logging of hours, site photos (GPS-tagged), and expenses.
- **Team Management**: Coordinate crew, assign jobs, and manage roles.
- **Offline Sync**: Works without signal; syncs automatically when back online.
